candidates.edition: NECA Ambush Predator2015 Convention Exclusive,7-inch-scale silver/chrome removable mask edition
candidates.camera: Near-front mask worn by the MAIN figure in the neutral white catalog; top-right head inset is unmasked, lower-right side inset is supplementary reflection/sculpt only.
candidates.design: Silver/dark silver Viper-family hard shell with two short swept upper corners, center ridge, paired inset forehead lobes, angular open brow/eye areas, small ridged nasal bridge, dark repeated respirator and two long silver down-curved cheek prongs.
candidates.exclusions: Transparent wearer/body/dreads/eyes/skull, black discolored biological eye surround, armor/weapons/cannon, backdrop. Green scene spill is light, not new pigment. Do not assume two different chrome paint editions from angle/reflection alone.

candidates.representationOf: Real NECA Ambush2015 convention edition; same Viper-family geometry, distinct photographed silver/chrome finish
limitations: Complete visible shell in neutral catalog is about158x246px, larger dramatic macro supports the sculpt only. Hidden rear/interior and exact microfinish cannot be recovered.
Silver/chrome finish reflects scene light; green spill on metal in dramatic photos is excluded from pigment. Only one photographed finish edition is claimed.
Wearer eyes versus mask optic treatment is qualified from masked/unmasked/package source set; any uncertain boundary is documented, not invented.
This NECA2015 edition does not prove the exact original Kenner1990s mail-away mask; no new geometry or canonical validation is claimed.

Independent source qualification compared four native photos: green bare-head eyes have the same appearance as through-mask eyes, while the detached accessory has no established green inserts. Wearer eyes removed, real orbit rims retained with transparent apertures; fine junction remains qualified.
Photographed silver/chrome appearance is retained without baking green scene reflections as paint. Exact measured BRDF and microfinish are not established.
Native framing retained without CPU correction, approximately5.8% upper/5.1% lower substantive alpha margin; complete corners and prongs are uncut.
Fine eye-aperture versus hypothetical clear-lens junction remains qualified; do not certify a glass construction or manufacture solid green inserts from wearer eyes.
Small primary shell~158x246px and dramatic macro cannot establish exact microfinish, hidden rear/interior or calibrated camera; slight front balancing remains a source-view approximation.
This actual NECA2015 convention edition does not establish exact original Kenner1990s mail-away geometry or new canonical geometry.
Native lower B margin32px (~2.3%) is below requested target but whole cheek prongs remain uncut. No CPU framing or alpha cleanup.

candidates.work: Predator1987 film licensed30th Anniversary toy edition
candidates.edition: NECA Jungle Demon30th Anniversary2017,1/4-scale,camouflage/phase finish with published LED eyes
candidates.camera: Almost front slightly downward mask of the primary neutral white-background full figure; secondary side photo/package confirm material and named1/4edition only.
candidates.design: JungleHunter-family shell in real dark gray/green camouflage phase finish, irregular olive/tan-green blotches, partial clear/frosted upper rim/crown areas, yellow lit eye lenses and original small targeting fittings.
candidates.exclusions: All clear/camouflage body, skin, dreads, neck/collar, necklace, cannon, clear targeting support/hoses behind shell, arms/weapons/background/packaging. Do not paint the primary white backdrop onto clear sections.
candidates.maskFamily: Jungle Hunter shell family, Jungle Demon2017 quarter-scale finish
candidates.representationOf: Real NECA1/4-scale2017 camouflage/phase edition; same JungleHunter geometry, distinct documented paint/material and yellow LED state
limitations: Mask area in the neutral primary is about156x203px. Irregular camouflage placement and lit yellow eye state are visible; microscopic finish cannot be recovered exactly.

Clear/frosted portions are photographed against a white background; precise transmission/refraction and hidden rear are not recoverable. Preserve visible shell contour, without treating backdrop as white paint.

Manufacturer explicitly describes clear plastic, camouflage accents and yellow/red LED effects. Retain the yellow lit eyes visible in the primary, but do not invent red targeting glow that is not visibly lit there.
The local catalogue calls Jungle Demon a KennerTribute alias; this source proves specifically the1/4-scale30th2017 film edition. Do not substitute another size/edition or count new geometry.

Independent source preflight opened primary, black-background side photo and package: the frosted/milky upper mask appears white on both white and black backgrounds. Near-opaque photographed appearance retained; physical transmission/refraction and reusable glass-material behavior are NOT validated.
Upper milky material is almost opaque in the generated alpha (sample alpha about253); do not mistake this source-view appearance study for physically accurate transparency.
Native framing retained unedited; substantive alpha16 upper margin9.2% and lower3.8%, contour whole. Exact notch/camouflage boundaries remain limited by source resolution.
This is an appearance study of the specifically named licensed1/4-scale JungleDemon2017edition, not the unrelated local KennerTribute alias or a new canonical geometry.
The primary mask is only about150x205source pixels; exact camouflage edges, surface microfinish and small fittings cannot be recovered or certified1:1.
The exact rear crown notch shape/depth is limited by white-on-white primary and oblique supporting view. A/B keep a restrained visible notch, but it is not certified as exact geometry.

Upper frosted area is nearly opaque in native PNG alpha (samples around253); this is a source-view appearance reproduction only. Physical transmission, refraction and reusable clear/glass shader behavior are NOT validated.
B keeps the same near-opaque milky source appearance. It must not be presented as a physically accurate transparent3Dmaterial asset.
Native minimum lower margins around4% are below8–12%request, with complete rigid outline and no clipping; no raster reframe or cleanup.
Canon certification, human art signoff, runtime integration and production readiness remain false.
